department: Center for Neuroscience at the University of Pittsburgh (CNUP)

deadline.value: Application deadline is December 1; interviews are held in person in late January to early February.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are neither needed nor accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not needed nor accepted.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores, including the Psychology subject test, are neither needed nor accepted.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not needed nor accepted.

toefl_min.value: CNUP requires TOEFL iBT 100 with at least 22 in each section (stated on the old 0-120 scale).
toefl_min.quote: CNUP requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100, with a minimum score of 22 in each section.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

funding.value: Not stated on the pages checked

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: CNUP requires an in-person interview for all finalists, travel support only for applicants within the U.S., and applicants must be physically in the U.S. at the time of the interview (late January to early February); applicants not available for it will not be considered.
